# dspace.library.uu.nl

> > Digital repository and institutional archive for Utrecht University scholarly works and research outputs.

DSpace is an open-source repository platform used by Utrecht University Library to preserve and provide access to academic publications, research data, theses, and other scholarly materials. The system supports metadata management, persistent identifiers, and OAI-PMH harvesting for academic content discovery.

## Key Topics

- DSpace repository platform
- Utrecht University Library
- Institutional repository
- Open access publishing
- Academic research outputs
- Scholarly communication
- Digital preservation
- Metadata standards
- OAI-PMH protocol
- Persistent identifiers
- Theses and dissertations
- Research data management
- Collection management
- Academic archives

## Core Repository Access

- [DSpace Repository Homepage](https://dspace.library.uu.nl): Main entry point to Utrecht University's institutional repository

## Collections and Browse

- [Browse Collections](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/collections): Organized academic collections by faculty and department
- [Browse by Author](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/browse/author): Search repository contents by author name
- [Browse by Subject](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/browse/subject): Navigate research outputs by subject classification

## Search and Discovery

- [Advanced Search](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/search): Advanced search interface with filters and facets
- [Recent Submissions](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/recent): Latest additions to the repository

## Help and Documentation

- [Repository Help](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/help): User guide for navigating and using the repository
- [Deposit Guidelines](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/submit): Instructions for submitting research outputs

## Optional

- [Terms of Use](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/terms): Legal terms and conditions for repository usage
- [Privacy Policy](https://dspace.library.uu.nl/privacy): Data protection and privacy information
